text.card: A red giant 1,166 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.93 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,839 K at its surface.
